node.statement: The two fixed diagonal maps. A reset-state tag says v_U:B_U->A_U=S^A_{P_U} is an extended d_U-isomorphism and v_V:B_V->A_V=S^A_{P_V} is an extended d_V-isomorphism, with fixed amplifications I_n tensor v_U and I_n tensor v_V. Since 0<=d_U,d_V<=t, every homomorphism-defect inequality and both (1 plus-or-minus defect) norm inequalities in def-extended-delta-inclusion only weaken when d_U or d_V is replaced by t; hence both are extended t-isomorphisms. Apply lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer twice, with (R,P,v)=(P_R,P_U,v_U) and (P_R,P_V,v_V). The resulting explicit maps T_U=Co^{A_R}_{P_U^R} o Co^A_{P_R} o v_U and T_V=Co^{A_R}_{P_V^R} o Co^A_{P_R} o v_V are extended C_out*t-isomorphisms onto S^{A_R}_{P_U^R} and S^{A_R}_{P_V^R}, and at every n their maps are exactly I_n tensor T_U and I_n tensor T_V. Their common defect is at most C_cross*t.
